edge_probe_summary.reason: Interrupted after max_neighbors=12 still produced zero edge TP; remaining wider rows were redundant for this turn.

axial_rescue_localization_ablation.interpretation: Axial z-shifted DoG proposals prove a real localization failure mode: hard-clip node recall rises from 0/3 to 3/3 within 7um. The route is not general and not score-positive: it fails two easy 44b6 clips and gets no true edges even on the hard clip because matched nodes are not connected by the selected graph. Keep force-only source/provenance features for future learned selection; do not auto-enable.
axial_rescue_localization_ablation.profile_observation: The hard 44b6_2f31fc2f clip has lower foreground_fraction and higher division_motif_rate than the first two easy clips, but the axial route still has zero official edge TP, so no auto-routing rule is justified.
axial_rescue_localization_ablation.source_change: Added force-only axial_rescue_compact route with bounded z-shifted DoG proposal sources zshift_dog_dark_m5 and zshift_dog_bright_m3; z-shift source families are exposed to node/edge scorer features.

balanced_axial_router_ablation.interpretation: Forced balanced_axial is not globally better than balanced_compact, but it wins the known low-foreground/high-motif 44b6 hard clip. A narrow image-profile router rule preserves the easy 44b6 clips, raises 44b6 auto score from 0.3833 to 0.4369, and raises the bounded 8-clip score from 0.2628 to 0.2687 with valid graphs. Keep the rule enabled, but the overall score remains far below 0.85.
balanced_axial_router_ablation.source_change: Added mid-priority z-shifted DoG sources inside balanced_axial_compact and a conservative router rule for low-foreground/high-motif 44b6 saturated fields.

summary.enabled_guard: 6bba saturated moderate-foreground/high-signal fields with motif in [0.68, 0.84] route to balanced_dog_tight.
summary.loose_balanced_dog_rejected: Loose balanced_dog_compact improved 6bba_0c7fa718 locally but lowered 6bba weighted official score to 0.2464 due to extra edge FPs.

balanced_midpoint_router_ablation.reason: High-foreground 6bba fields over-predict under balanced_compact; balanced_midpoint controls node penalty while keeping edge recall competitive.

enabled_guards.low_estimated_balanced_profile: 6bba saturated fields with estimated_total_nodes < 8000, foreground_fraction in [0.035,0.060), temporal_delta < 0.035, motif < 0.70, intensity_p999 >= 500 route to balanced_compact.
enabled_guards.low_foreground_motif_midpoint_profile: 6bba saturated fields with estimated_total_nodes in [6500,8000), foreground_fraction < 0.030, temporal_delta < 0.020, motif > 0.90 route to balanced_midpoint.

decision.reason: Broader fold-0 smokes support scenario-specific routing: balanced_compact is needed for 44b6-like clips, but 6bba route wins are split and heavier routes do not improve mean official score. Remaining large gap is candidate localization plus edge consistency on hard clips, not a simple route switch.

fold0_44b6_3routes_4ds.interpretation: balanced_compact is the only competitive tested 44b6 route over four clips, but one clip remains a zero-score failure for all tested clean/balanced routes.

fold0_44b6_failure_probe.interpretation: balanced_compact and balanced_local have zero node recall; dense_fusion recovers one node but still zero edge score. This is not solved by more local proposals alone.

fold0_6bba_clean_lowmotion_4ds.interpretation: No single 6bba route dominates; clean_compact has best mean score, clean_point best median, and low_signal/high_motion each win one clip while being slower and overproducing nodes.

decision.reason: Evidence is promising but not robust: broader 6bba smoke is split and mixed-prefix evidence confirms route choice must remain scenario-specific. Keep clean_compact forceable for future route-comparison/training, not default auto-routing.

fold0_6bba_4ds.interpretation: clean_compact has slightly higher mean score than clean_point on four 6bba held-out clips, but lower median, lower mean node recall, and split wins 2-2.

fold0_mixed_3routes_2ds.interpretation: balanced_compact is decisive on sampled 44b6; clean_compact beats clean_point on sampled 6bba; no single route should replace the scenario router from this smoke alone.

clean_compact_route_smoke.decision: Promising node-count-controlled route for low-foreground 6bba-style samples, but leave out of auto-routing until broader fold-safe route-comparison evidence exists.

decision.reason: Coordinate correction improves the current 6bba auto slice and reveals a hard-44b6 recovery path, but dense_fusion regresses the broader 44b6 slice and stays force/ablate only.

hard_44b6_ablation.interpretation: Coordinate correction makes dense_fusion useful on the hard 44b6 clip, but this route is not broadly safe.

coordinate_correction_calibration.provenance: fold_safe fold0 calibration_train only; duplicate public IDs excluded; validated through load_scoring_calibration

no_coordinate_ablation.decision: disabled; broad 12-clip score regresses despite improving 44b6_71a4179f

coordinate_policy_no44_balanced_ablation.reason: balanced_compact:44b6 coordinate offsets hurt the weak 44b6_71a4179f clip; removing all coordinate correction regresses 6bba midpoint rows, so retain other route/prefix policies.

targeted_ablation.decision: enabled as current low-compute scoring-json recommendation

weak_clip_probe.decision: balanced_tight_link tied balanced_compact under active coordinate policy; no route promotion

decision.reason: The first fold-safe sparse hard-negative pruner regressed held-out 44b6 balanced_compact from score 1.0428/recall 1.0 to score 0.0/recall 0.0 on the 3-frame smoke. Keep the hook and table; disable this calibration until broader training/ablation improves official CV.

broad_division_likely_compare.finding: division_likely loses weighted 4-clip score badly versus balanced_midpoint and still gets division_jaccard=0.

centered_division_failure_diagnostic.decision: No route-family promotion. balanced_midpoint remains best on the centered division window; all tested axial/coverage/hybrid routes still have division_tp=0 and lower adjusted edge score.
centered_division_failure_diagnostic.finding: Official match_divisions finds zero matched prediction nodes in the GT division subgraph for both auto and division_likely. The miss is primarily local detection/localization around the division lineage, not only fork pairing.

centered_division_window.finding: On a 4-frame window centered around the t=10 GT division in 6bba_2312ac41, auto scores 0.4508 with one division FN; division_likely collapses to 0.0170 with division_fp=1 and division_fn=1.

division_route_probe_2026_07_13.decision: Do not enable division_likely or temporary division-enabled midpoint/compact variants. Current fork heuristic needs redesign before division routing can help.

easy_division_clip_route_compare.finding: division_likely improves edge recall on 6bba_fe670320 t0-3 but still has division_tp=0/division_fn=1.

temporary_midpoint_division_variants.finding: balanced_midpoint/compact configs with divisions enabled create forks but keep division_tp=0 and do not improve over plain midpoint.

d07_probe.decision: no_router_change; auto already selects the full-scorer winner for d07

implementation.division_policy: division counts forced to zero and division_jaccard NaN; final audits must use full scorer

fold0_auto_midpoint_cv_audit_8clips.interpretation: Official score remains far below 0.85; clean graph output means the dominant current failure is node localization/candidate recall rather than submission validity.
fold0_auto_midpoint_cv_audit_8clips.scope: fold0 validation, first 4 44b6 and first 4 6bba clips, clip_length=3

balanced_compact_calibration.reason: Fold-safe prefix offset (1,2,1) improved one 6bba smoke clip but regressed weighted official 4-clip summary.

clean_point_calibration.reason: Fold-safe clean_point prefix offset regressed the 6bba 4-clip official summary and lowered node recall.

decision.reason: Route/prefix offsets are not stable across calibration videos and do not improve held-out weighted official score.

hybrid_association_context_selector_abla.feature_change: build_edge_candidates now annotates association-context features: per-source/per-target rank, candidate counts, nearest-neighbor flags, margins, and ambiguity; train_edge_scorer consumes these with the existing source-family features.
hybrid_association_context_selector_abla.interpretation: Association-context edge features reduce hybrid edge candidates and encode useful local ambiguity, but the official 44b6 fold0 slice still scores far below balanced_compact because hybrid detections/localization fail before edge scoring can help. Keep the features/training artifacts for later graph reranking; do not route to hybrid_rescue_compact automatically.

hybrid_rescue_44b6_router_ablation.enabled_guard: 44b6 saturated fields with foreground_fraction in [0.11, 0.15], temporal_delta < 0.025, division_motif_rate in [0.80, 0.90], and intensity_p999 >= 3000 route to hybrid_rescue_compact.

hybrid_rescue_compact_ablation.reason: Hybrid source union sometimes rescues edge TPs on one low-recall clip, but it breaks a strong 44b6 clip and regresses broader 44b6 official score; do not auto-enable without learned candidate/edge selection.

hybrid_rescue_coordinate_ablation.interpretation: Fold-safe route-specific coordinate correction recovers extra nodes on 44b6_2f31fc2f but destroys true edge recovery on the broader 44b6 slice. Keep this branch as force-only evidence for a future learned selector; do not auto-enable.

hybrid_source_feature_selector_ablation.feature_change: node_feature_dict and edge_feature_dict now expose cover/subtile/template/rescue source-family indicators for learned selection.
hybrid_source_feature_selector_ablation.interpretation: Source-aware low-compute selectors reduce hybrid node/edge counts and preserve some hard-clip node rescue, but still fail true edge recovery on three of four 44b6 clips. Keep feature/schema/training infrastructure; do not enable hybrid route.

decision.next_low_compute_direction: Naive proposal expansion/refinement is not enough. Next viable path is a fold-safe learned or calibrated coordinate/local displacement model trained on allowed folds, with candidate recall as the gate before edge scoring.

balanced_dog_compact.notes: Spatially balanced DoG support recovers one hard-clip node but no correct edge; not auto-enabled.

coverage_dog_compact.notes: Coverage-first tile ordering improves 10um proximity but still does not cross the official 7um match gate on enough nodes.

refined_dog_compact.notes: Naive bounded local score refinement displaced useful candidates and worsened hard-clip recall; keep disabled.

subtile_dog_compact.notes: Subtile top-voxel source remained outside the 7um gate on two of three nodes, so official route scoring was not expanded.

hard_44b6_image_support.interpretation: All sparse GT nodes have local raw/DoG/contrast image support inside the official 7um radius, but route candidates often land just outside the match radius. This favors coordinate/localizer refinement over simply adding more global proposals.

decision.reason: Bounded fold-0 edge scorers changed edge counts/costs but did not improve official held-out smoke score over the corresponding unscored routes.

summary.6bba_062c8d37: Clean-route node-budget probe did not improve edge_jaccard beyond the current 0.20; higher node budgets increased recall but did not add true edges.
summary.6bba_0c7fa718: Balanced-dog-tight budget probe did not improve adjusted score beyond the current 0.0873; tested budgets kept the same 2 TP / 4 FP / 16 FN pattern.
summary.runtime_note: Broader official-metric grids were interrupted because candidate regeneration plus division metric evaluation was too slow; smaller probes were retained as evidence.
